name: ze_Pd6_MFI
title: Pd6 @ MFI (channel intersection)
description: Pd6 cluster at the intersection of the straight and sinusoidal 10-ring channels of a frozen all-silica MFI framework (silicalite-1; NEP89-relaxed orthorhombic cell, 288 framework atoms). Sub-nanometre Pd clusters confined in silicalite-1 (Wang et al., J. Am. Chem. Soc. 138, 7484 (2016)) and MFI-encapsulated noble-metal clusters (Goel, Zones and Iglesia, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 136, 15280 (2014)) are sinter-resistant catalysts. Caveat: NEP89 is not fitted to metal/zeolite interfaces and the framework is rigid, so cluster-wall binding is qualitative.
